entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The former queen and mother of the faeries on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, a flower-like ur-faerie who puppeteered the Great Aurora and was dethroned by her daughter Maralen.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane that cycles between the light of Lorwyn and the dark of Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Oona's hidden haven, shielded by glamers.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The planar transformation between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor that Oona manipulated to preserve her memories.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Oona's first faerie sibling creation, a shapeshifter who rebelled, left, and became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Oona's younger daughter, placed in an elf's body, who gained sentience, defeated Oona and became queen of the fae.

entities.name: The giant sage
entities.description: A giant sage who befriended Oko and told him of Eirdu and Isilu; Oona ordered his death.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: The incarnation of day, faded to legend after Oona seized control and later reawakened.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The incarnation of night, faded to legend after Oona seized control and later reawakened.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: The last living yew, whom Oona spies on.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: A trio of faerie emissaries Oona created as scouts and spies.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: An elemental whose power Oona tried to take.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: An ally who helps Maralen thwart Oona.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: An ally who helps Maralen thwart Oona.

entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: A character who sacrifices himself to sever Oona's connection to the elves.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An ally who helps defeat Oona and whom Maralen entrusts to kill her if Oona returns.

entities.name: Sapling of Colfenor
entities.description: A sapling that sacrifices itself to help defeat Oona.

entities.name: Cayr Ulios
entities.description: The elf city where Oona takes control of the king and queen and imprisons its elves.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oona's grandchild, whom she beckons to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Grove of the Aurora Queen
entities.description: The grounds across which Oona's shattered soul was cast.

events.summary: Oona senses the Great Aurora approaching prematurely and plots to remain in power and unchanged through the plane's transformation.
events.quote: Oona began to plot to ensure that she remained in power and unchanged when the plane’s transformation occurred.

events.summary: Oona creates two faerie siblings, the first of whom, Oko, is meant to rule Shadowmoor but rebels.
events.quote: This sibling rebelled and desired to rule in adherence to the natural cycle of the world

events.summary: Oona orders the death of Oko's father-figure; Oko vanishes vowing never to forgive her.
events.quote: Oona ordered the death of her progeny's newfound father-figure

events.summary: Oona raises her younger daughter in seclusion and deprives her of warmth as a weapon against the coming aurora.
events.quote: The faerie was reared to be a weapon against the world that Oona feared would rise against her

events.summary: In 4520 AR Oona spies on Colfenor through the Vendilion clique, which she created as scouts.
events.quote: a trio of faerie emissaries that she created in the face of the Great Aurora to act as her personal scouts and spies

events.summary: Oona kills the elf Maralen and replaces her with her half-formed daughter, who gains unintended sentience; the Vendilion bring her before Oona.
events.quote: Oona used her magic to kill an elf woman named Maralen and replaced her with her half-formed daughter

events.summary: Maralen returns to her companions unaware she travels with Oona's spies, and conflict grows between her and Oona.
events.quote: the insuppressible autonomy of Maralen quickly led to unresolved conflict between the two

events.summary: Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power but is thwarted by Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg, then retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves.
events.quote: She tried to take the elemental power of Ashling , but was thwarted by Maralen

events.summary: Gryffid sacrifices himself to sever Oona's hold on the elves and weaken her.
events.quote: Her control was thwarted when Gryffid sacrificed himself to sever her connection to the Elves and weaken her.

events.summary: Maralen and Oona fight in single combat above Cayr Ulios while their faerie armies clash.
events.quote: The two engaged in single combat as their Faerie armies clashed with each other.

events.summary: Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental; Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.
events.quote: Maralen took her place as queen of the fae as day returned to the plane.

events.summary: Though her body is destroyed, Oona's consciousness survives in the plane and she creates a new trio of faeries to replace the Vendilion.
events.quote: she created a new trio of Faeries to replace the Vendilion clique

events.summary: With Oona's control broken, Eirdu and Isilu reawaken and the day-night cycle begins to merge again.
events.quote: Eirdu and Isilu, were reawakened as the twin aspects of the plane began to merge once more

events.summary: Forty years later Oko returns and Maralen fears Oona's return; the siblings reconcile before Eirdu and Isilu.
events.quote: The siblings, rejoined for the first time in decades, reconciled in the presence of Eirdu and Isilu

events.summary: Oona contacts her grandchild Kellan worlds away and beckons him to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

relations.note: created him as her heir and prince of Shadowmoor
relations.quote: The first sibling, Oko , was created to bear her mantle into the coming Shadowmoor
